Title: Q about being burnt by aggravated dam

Messages.Author: Robert Patton
Messages.Body:
I'm not sure that I understand the system for being burnt by aggravated
damage. Here are my questions: 1) If you do 2 aggravated damage to a
vampire with one blood, is it burnt? Or does it need to take 3 agg.
damage? 2) Does a vampire hit by aggravated damage go directly into
torpor at the end of the strike, or does it stay in combat until the end of
the round?

Please post some answers, these questions have come up over and over again
in my games. Thanks!

Messages.Author: Larry Harriman
Messages.Body:
Robert Patton (Robert...@mail.trincoll.edu) wrote:
: I'm not sure that I understand the system for being burnt by aggravated

: damage. Here are my questions: 1) If you do 2 aggravated damage to a
: vampire with one blood, is it burnt? Or does it need to take 3 agg.
: damage? 2) Does a vampire hit by aggravated damage go directly into
: torpor at the end of the strike, or does it stay in combat until the end of
: the round?

To burn a vampire you must do x + 2 damage to it where x is the blood on the
vampire, and at least two points of the damage is aggravated.

A vampire is sent to torpor as soon as a strike which would send it to torpor
is resolved. There are no extra stikes, and no presses.

: Please post some answers, these questions have come up over and over again
: in my games. Thanks!

Your welcome,
Larrx...

Messages.Author: William S. Westermann
Messages.Body:
In a previous article Robert Patton wrote :

>I'm not sure that I understand the system for being burnt by aggravated
>damage. Here are my questions: 1) If you do 2 aggravated damage to a
>vampire with one blood, is it burnt? Or does it need to take 3 agg.
>damage? 2) Does a vampire hit by aggravated damage go directly into
>torpor at the end of the strike, or does it stay in combat until the end of
>the round?

It takes 2 aggravated damage to burn a vampire plus damage equal to the
blood remaining on it. Therefore, to burn the vamp, you need atleast

1 regular + 2 aggravated or
3 or more aggravated.

Scott.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Robert...@mail.trincoll.edu (Robert Patton) writes:

>I'm not sure that I understand the system for being burnt by aggravated
>damage. Here are my questions: 1) If you do 2 aggravated damage to a
>vampire with one blood, is it burnt? Or does it need to take 3 agg.
>damage? 2) Does a vampire hit by aggravated damage go directly into
>torpor at the end of the strike, or does it stay in combat until the end of
>the round?

A vampire must take 2+X points of aggravated damage from a single strike
tp be burned (where X is the number of blood on the vampire)
Your example vampire would have to take three.
Any vampire taking aggravated damage (and not preventing it) goes to
torpor when the strike resolves, not waiting for the end of the
round.
